segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמּוֹכֵר עַבְדּוֹ לַגּוֹיִם אוֹ לְחוּצָה לָאָרֶץ – יָצָא בֶּן חוֹרִין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In a case of «one who sells his slave to gentiles, or» even «to» a Jew «outside of Eretz» Yisrael, the slave «is emancipated.» Since the slave, who is partially obligated in the fulfillment of mitzvot, would be restricted in his ability to fulfill them in his new situation, either because he would be under the authority of a gentile or because he will no longer be in Eretz Yisrael, the Sages penalized his original owner that he should become a freeman, so that if he succeeds in escaping his new owner, he is a full-fledged freeman.

moves.summary: rules the sold slave is emancipated

positions.claim: a slave sold to gentiles or abroad goes free
positions.basis: rabbinic penalty for removing him from mitzvot (biur)
